mapper.select: SELECT ep.ep_id, ep.exam_id, ep.student_id, ep.join_status, ep.join_time, ep.submit_time, u.username, u.real_name FROM exam_participant ep LEFT JOIN user u ON ep.student_id = u.user_id WHERE ep.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY ep.ep_id ASC
